_doc: Xianxia dress sheets, v1 (the user preferred v1 over the rank-uniform v2 on 2026-11-26). Keys x:<sect>.
x:bang_tam: Băng Tâm Các, the Ice sect of the frozen north: flowing layered robes of white silk and frost-pale gauze, three crossed collars edged in ice blue, wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with silver snowflakes and frost ferns, a sash of shimmering frost silk hung with a white jade pendant; elders wear a pale blue gauze over-robe that drifts like mist; hair long, dressed with white jade or silver hairpins.
x:coc_vu: Cốc Vũ Quán, the rain-calling rice abbey: soft robes of rain-grey and rice-green silk, a pale grey gauze over-robe beaded as if with dew, collars embroidered with falling rain and rice ears, a sash with a small green jade drop; a light rice-straw hat on a silk cord for the terraces.
x:da_quang: Dạ Quang Môn, the night-glow riders of the desert edge: robes of deep night-blue and dune-gold silk, a flowing sand-coloured gauze over-robe, collars embroidered with crescent moons and stars in pale gold, a sash with a glowing jade cup; hair bound under a dark silk headwrap with a gold pin.
x:muc_van: Mục Vân Trang, the cloud-herder horse manor of the western plain: riding robes of fine grass-green and cloud-white silk, a sky-blue gauze over-robe, collars embroidered with running horses and clouds, a broad sash with a white jade horse; hair in a high knot with a silver ring.
x:phat_y: Phất Y Cốc, the valley of hired swords: long robes of fine grey silk with a silver-grey gauze over-robe, the left sleeve long and flowing past the hand, collars edged in charcoal, a narrow sash with a small silver sword-token; hair bound in a high knot with a plain silver crown.
x:phuong_minh: Phượng Minh Cung, the Fire court of the phoenix: splendid layered robes of vermilion, gold and dawn-orange silk, collars and hems embroidered with phoenix feathers and flames in gold thread, wide trailing sleeves, a gold sash with red jade; hair piled high with gold phoenix hairpins and a small flame-shaped crown.
x:thien_xu: Thiên Xu Tông, the Pivot of the central plateau: stately robes of deep bronze and earth-gold silk under a dark iron-grey over-robe, collars embroidered with the seven Dipper stars and mountain ridges in gold, a broad sash with a heavy yellow jade seal; elders wear a black silk outer robe with a high collar; hair under a gold or bronze crown.
x:thinh_vu: Thính Vũ Lâu, the Tower Where One Listens to the Rain, a dark Thunder house: robes of black and storm-violet silk, a long black oiled-silk over-robe that falls like rain, collars and cuffs embroidered with silver lightning and raindrops, a sash hung with a bronze bell; hair bound with dark silver hairpins.
x:thu_phan: Thu Phần Các, the ma đạo grave-keepers among the old graves: mourning robes of undyed white and ash-grey silk, a translucent black gauze over-robe like smoke, collars embroidered with withered lotus and grave-incense curls in dull silver, a sash with a dark resentment-jade seal; hair long and loose, held by a single bone hairpin.
x:tung_dao: Tùng Đào Cung, the palace of the pine sea: flowing robes of soft pine-green and pale bark-cream silk, collars and hems embroidered with pine needles and wind-curls in darker green, a needle-green silk sash for inner disciples with a green jade pine-cone pendant; elders wear grey-green gauze over-robes; hair long, pinned with a jade pine-twig hairpin.
